# GOGO CHINA TRIPS

> GOGO CHINA TRIPS makes it easy for foreign travellers and business visitors to
> discover, book and enjoy understandable, reliable local experiences in China —
> with English support, transparent pricing and real local guides.
> Tagline: "China, made easy."

## Experiences
- First Day in China: on-arrival assistance — SIM & payment setup, getting around, a smooth day one.
- Private Guides (4H / 8H): English-speaking local guides, by language or by city.
- Business Travel: trade-fair companions, factory visits, interpreters, transport and market research — quoted as one project.
- Plan My Trip: custom China trips planned around your dates, cities, group and interests.

## First-launch cities
- Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou (more cities — Chengdu, Shenzhen, Xi'an — rolling out).

## How booking works
- Choose and pay with full price, inclusions and cancellation policy shown up front.
- Many experiences are "request to confirm": we confirm the guide and resources, usually within 4 hours.
- You receive a bilingual trip card (meeting point, English + Chinese address, guide, emergency contact).
- If a supplier can't confirm, you get an alternative or a full refund.

## For partners
- Hotels, schools, communities and individuals can refer travellers with a unique link or invite code, with transparent order attribution and commission: https://partners.gogochinatrips.com
